# Culinary

> A culinary arts school in Chile offering professional cooking and pastry programs with 2025 admissions across Santiago and Viña del Mar locations.

Culinary is a Chilean culinary education institution specializing in foundational and advanced cooking techniques, pastry arts, and culinary business administration. The school serves students seeking professional credentials in gastronomy and food service management.

## Key Topics

- Técnicas Básicas de Cocina
- Técnicas Básicas de Pastelería
- Cocina Nikkei
- Parrilla
- Pastas
- Postres al Vaso
- Técnico en Artes Culinarias
- Administración de Artes Culinarias y Servicios
- Santiago
- Viña del Mar
- Admissions 2025
- Professional Programs
- Continuing Education
- Pastry Arts
- Culinary Techniques

## Admissions & Programs

- [Culinary – Admisión 2025](https://culinary.cl): Culinary school homepage featuring 2025 admissions and course programs in Santiago and Viña del Mar
